verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a README note that you can validate an unpublished checkout with an isolated configuration directory and a local marketplace path, without changing your normal settings. That is a narrow form of test isolation for the skills install itself, not a sandbox for Ledger or project data. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment for Ledger and agent actions, documented separation from production data, dry-run modes for destructive ledger operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
